note: The custom-node packs a run-graph manifest may name, by repository. A manifest that names a pack whose repository is not a row here is refused before any clone (render/node-packs.mjs, internal/mediacap/nodepacks.go). The node installs the head of the repository's default branch and records the commit it got (custom_nodes/<pack>.installed.json: repo, commit, installed_at); no commit is written here. A change to this file is a change to what any holder of the fleet bearer can make a node run or fetch: a reviewed edit, with the Go copy in internal/mediacap/nodepacks.go changed with it (a test holds the two together).
model_hosts_note: The hosts a run-graph manifest's models[] source_url may name: https only, and the host is one of these or a subdomain of one. A model also lands only under models/<class>/ (render/node-packs.mjs checkModelEntry, internal/mediacap/manifestmodels.go). Adding a host lets any holder of the fleet bearer make a node fetch from it: a reviewed edit, with the Go copy changed with it.
